title: Andalusia 💞
text: We had an excellent day out with our guide David. He arrived promptly to spend our full day touring white villages and Ronda. David shared a lot of interesting stories along the way and provided great information on everything from the olive processes, the history of the area and white villages, to recommendations on where to go & what to see while we are here, along with some photography tips. Our trip was flexible and catered to what we wanted to see, allowing us time to wander & also be guided, along with some extra stops on the return for vultures and dragons! We will seek you out David if
author: 75JM75

title: Beautiful trip through beautiful towns!
text: Luis was an excellent and engaging guide. He was flexible and gave his guidance and opinion.  We visited Setenil, Ronda and Zahara.  Picturesque and awe-inspiring towns.   Luis took some local back roads that would’ve been a challenge for first time drivers in the areas but it provided us with great views.  He made the trip very memorable.
author: pelayo_c

title: Amazing day visiting the white villages
text:
My husband and I enjoyed the trip to Ronda with other picturesque stops along the way. Nacho was our guide. He knows the history very well and took the driving time to explain it pointing out interesting aspects of the areas we were passing through. I took beautiful photos on this trip. 
Highly recommend it. Another plus is that it was not as hot at the white village as it was in Seville.
author: sylvieFS

title: A day to remember!
text: Luis was my main point of contact in the planning stage and he was very communicative, professional and insightful. He paired us with Javi for our day trip to Ronda and white villages and we had the absolute best experience! Javi asked questions and listened to our interests and gave us some unique experiences you can’t get on a big bus tour. He was fun to spend the day with and had great energy which fueled our time together. I highly recommend Javi, Luis and anyone from Andalusia Guided Tours! If we are ever traveling anywhere they do a tour, they are our people! PS... only added a few photo
author: 240ruthd

title: Excellent private tour and Luis is the best guide!
text: We are a group of 8 friends. We booked a private tour for Rhonda and White villages. Luis picked us up at our apartment on time. He has very good driving skill especially driving through all those narrow hilly roads. During several occasions, he picked a parking spot on a higher ground and walked us down to the sightseeing place so that it would be easier for us to walk downhill. He then walked back up to the van and drove down to pick us up so we didn’t need to walk back up. He is  very energetic, friendly and knowledgeable. We all had a wonderful day and highly recommend him as a private gui
author: sugarlandJo

title: Wite Villages Tour
text: Our guide, Javi, was truly exceptional. He was friendly, upbeat, and knowledgeable. In addition to being a great guide, he also recommended places to visit and eat and to watch Flamenco  in Sevilla. I highly recommend this tour.
author: 719SandraB

title: Spectacular experience!
text: We had a spectacular time with Luis and Miguel. They gave us a lot of information about the places we were passing through, and of course, about Setenil de Las Bodegas, Ronda, and Malaga. They were very courteous and respectful of what we wanted to do. We recommend them 100%.
author: irisdejurado

title: Ronda + villages + enjoyable surprises!!
text:
Javi provided us a most memorable road trip to white villages and Ronda.  
We appreciate that Javi was in direct contact a few days before the tour, answered questions, and then picked us up at our hotel.
Javi was a pleasure to talk with and learn from on our way to visit the villages, and then on to Ronda.  
He picked out a special venue for lunch in the 2nd village and explained Salmorejo vs Gazpacho (as an example). 
We took a short hike to take in a view and spotted an Iberian Ibex (lucky for us). 
Finally Ronda was really spectacular... the cliffs, the bridge, and the scenic walk.  
Javi
author: David_M

title: A great day!
text: Luis is a great guide: he has a lot of culture and knowledge of the region, so he offered us a lot of information and interesting curiosities. He is also very patient and fun, making the day go smoothly and pleasantly. The car is comfortable and the flexibility of the itinerary allows you to make the most of it.
author: Nivia47

title: A Most See!
text: Javi, our guide gave us an experience that went above and beyond our expectations.   His knowledge of all the towns we visited were so helpful in getting the best of each place in the time we had, but never feeling rushed.  Beautiful day!
author: Carmen_R
